start: Owner online, Expenses (Money group of the menu), this month, nothing added

steps.action: Tap '+ Add expense'; in 'Add expense' fill 'Amount', 'What for', 'Date', 'Note (optional)'; tap 'Save expense'
user_sees: Title 'Expenses', subtitle 'What went out, and what the gym kept'
'No expenses this month' with 'Add rent, salaries, electricity and the rest to see what the gym really kept.'
The page jumps to the month of the expense
must_not: Two expenses from a second press
The expense in the wrong month
A refunded or voided receipt counted in Collected
Totals that do not add up

start: Owner on the Add expense sheet

steps.action: Save with no amount, with letters, with 0, with a future date, with a year far in the past
user_sees: 'That amount looks wrong. Type it again.'
'The expense date can’t be in the future.'
'That date looks wrong. Check the year.'
must_not: An expense saved with a wrong amount or date

start: Owner online; one expense this month and one last month

steps.action: Tap the remove button on a row; in 'Remove this expense?' tap 'Keep it', then again and tap 'Remove'
user_sees: Expenses and Profit change by that amount
must_not: The expense removed on Keep it

user_sees: Last month’s figures, then this month’s
'Next month' is off on the current month
must_not: This month’s expense shown in last month

start: A staff person signed in on the same gym

steps.action: Staff looks at the menu and types the Expenses address
user_sees: No Expenses entry; the address does not open the page
must_not: Staff seeing Collected, Expenses or Profit
An expense note shown to staff elsewhere
